steps.name: keyStorage GREEN + C4b gap closure
criteria: Pasted key, once set, is exactly what get() returns next (roundtrip property)
Clearing a rejected key leaves no trace for the next fetch to reuse
A never-stored key answers get() with null, not a crash
New: clear() on a never-set key is a clean no-op, not an error (C4b)
steps.scenario_name: keyStorage -- the operator's pasted API key survives a page reload
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (TypeScript/Vitest project): keyStorage uses fast-check property tests (already scaffolded). New C4b gap test is example-based -- single boolean no-op assertion, not usefully quantifiable. STAGE CONTEXT: NEW code, Stage 0 (paradigm-from-day-zero), greenfield scaffold. Effect boundary: sole localStorage accessor (Core Principle 12 capability injection).

steps.name: apiClient GREEN + C4a/C6a/C6c gap closure
criteria: fetchVerdict sends the stored operator key and returns the verdict (walking skeleton, already enabled)
fetchEntries(accountId) requests exactly the clicked account's entries with the same key
A rejected (401) key clears itself; no write method is exposed on the client
Timeout and network-error read identically to the operator (fetch-failed signal)
New: repeated fetchVerdict() calls cause no accumulated side effect (C4a); malformed response yields typed failure, not silent undefined (C6a); only auth-rejected/fetch-failed ever escape (C6c)
steps.scenario_name: apiClient -- the operator's browser asks the API whether the books balance
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (TypeScript/Vitest project): apiClient uses fast-check property tests (already scaffolded, e.g. timeout/network-error equivalence). New C4a/C6a/C6c gap tests also use fast-check where the input space is meaningfully quantifiable (malformed response shapes), example-based otherwise. STAGE CONTEXT: NEW code, Stage 0, greenfield scaffold. Sole fetch() caller, GET-only, 8s AbortController timeout (SA-D6), bounded-change contract shape.

steps.name: ConsoleApp, ApiKeyPrompt, VerdictBanner GREEN (US-1 skeleton)
criteria: No stored key shows the key-entry form; a stored key goes straight to the verdict flow
A 401 re-shows the key form labeled 'key rejected', not the blank first-load form
Pasted key is masked (type=password) and handed to keyStorage on submit
Verdict sentence renders first, above any table, for healthy/empty/corrupted ledgers
While the fetch is outstanding, page shows 'Checking the books...', never blank; once resolved, verdict is labeled with client-observed fetchedAt
steps.scenario_name: ConsoleApp -- key-gate / verdict / error-rejected state machine
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (TypeScript/Vitest project): all three components use @testing-library/react example-based prop-to-render tests (already scaffolded); PBT adds no value over a pure-function render's small, enumerable prop space. STAGE CONTEXT: NEW code, Stage 0, greenfield scaffold. ConsoleApp is bounded-change (owns declared page-level UI state); ApiKeyPrompt and VerdictBanner are pure-function renders.

steps.name: ConsoleApp full wiring: DriftTable, EntryTrace, error-type-aware fetch failure
criteria: On fetchVerdict success with non-empty drifted[], DriftTable renders below VerdictBanner listing each drifted account
Clicking a DriftTable row calls apiClient.fetchEntries(accountId) and renders EntryTrace for that account (loading -> loaded/error)
A FetchFailedError from fetchVerdict (network/timeout) renders VerdictFetchError naming GET /health/trial-balance, NOT the key-rejected prompt
An AuthRejectedError from fetchVerdict (401) still renders ApiKeyPrompt with rejected=true, unchanged from step 01-03
No client-side balance recomputation anywhere in the new wiring (props passed verbatim from apiClient responses)
steps.scenario_name: ConsoleApp -- full wiring: drift table, entry trace, and error-type-aware fetch failure (gap found at Post-Merge Integration Gate, not a DISTILL-authored scenario -- DDR-2 leaves top-level browser wiring an untested seam; this step ADDS integration-level unit tests against ConsoleApp to close the TBU gap component-level tests could not catch)
steps.implementation_notes: GAP-CLOSURE STEP (orchestrator-added at Phase 3.5 Post-Merge Integration Gate, not part of original DISTILL scaffold roster): DriftTable, EntryTrace, VerdictFetchError were each GREEN in isolation (steps 02-01/03-01/04-01) but never wired into ConsoleApp, which only rendered ApiKeyPrompt/VerdictBanner. Additionally ConsoleApp.catch() collapsed AuthRejectedError and FetchFailedError into the same key-rejected state -- a real bug, not just missing wiring: a network failure would incorrectly show the key-entry prompt instead of VerdictFetchError. TEST PARADIGM: @testing-library/react example-based tests, extending ConsoleApp.test.tsx with new integration-shaped cases (mocking apiClient at the ConsoleApp boundary, as the existing tests already do).

steps.name: Vite app entry point (index.html + src/main.tsx) mounting ConsoleApp
criteria: npm run build (tsc --noEmit && vite build) succeeds and produces web/console/dist/index.html + assets
src/main.tsx mounts <ConsoleApp keyStorage={createKeyStorage()} apiClient={createApiClient({keyStorage})} /> into a DOM root via ReactDOM.createRoot
index.html has a root div matching the id main.tsx mounts against, and a <script type=module src=/src/main.tsx> (Vite convention)
steps.scenario_name: Vite entry point -- documented untested seam per DDR-2 (browser-level mount is out of automated scope); verified by npm run build succeeding, not a unit test
steps.implementation_notes: GAP-CLOSURE STEP (orchestrator-added at Phase 3.5 Post-Merge Integration Gate). No DISTILL scaffold or test covers this file -- DDR-2 explicitly carves the browser-rendering seam out of automated test scope, and this is exactly that seam: the file that actually calls ReactDOM.createRoot(...).render(<ConsoleApp .../>) against a real DOM element in a real browser. Without it,  fails ("Could not resolve entry module index.html") and internal/adapters/http/console_static.go (already built, DEVOPS wave) has nothing to serve at GET /console -- the whole feature is unreachable end-to-end without this file existing, even though every component passes its own unit tests. Verification is  succeeding + manual dogfood per DDR-2/DoD item 2, not a new automated test.

steps.name: DriftTable GREEN
criteria: A single drifted account renders with stored, computed, and delta values
A healthy ledger renders no drift table at all (n=0)
Two drifted accounts are both named, each with its own numbers (n=many)
A healthy account is never swept into the drift table
Clicking a row hands the console the exact account_id clicked (US-2 -> US-3 handoff)
steps.scenario_name: DriftTable -- renders one row per drifted account
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (TypeScript/Vitest project): @testing-library/react example-based prop-to-render tests (already scaffolded), covering n=0/1/many per Self-Completeness C3. STAGE CONTEXT: NEW code, Stage 0, greenfield scaffold. Pure-function render over drifted: DriftRow[]; no fetch, no localStorage.

phases.name: US-3: trace a drifted account to its entries

steps.name: EntryTrace GREEN
criteria: Clicking a drifted account shows its entries, ordered, with a running balance column
Each entry shows counterparty and recorded_at alongside amount and running balance
A healthy account's trace shows no divergence at any row
Loading state renders a neutral non-blank panel, mirroring VerdictBanner's pattern
A failed or timed-out entries fetch names the exact GET /accounts/{id}/entries URL as fallback, no blank panel or indefinite spinner
steps.scenario_name: EntryTrace -- fetches and renders entries for a clicked account
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (TypeScript/Vitest project): @testing-library/react example-based prop/fetched-state-to-render tests (already scaffolded). STAGE CONTEXT: NEW code, Stage 0, greenfield scaffold. Render is pure over fetched state; fetch itself delegated to apiClient (built in 01-02), never inlined. Three states mirror VerdictBanner's loading/loaded/error pattern.

phases.name: US-4: console failure does not strand the operator

steps.name: VerdictFetchError GREEN
criteria: A failed or timed-out verdict fetch renders an explicit error, never a blank page or unending spinner
The error text names GET /health/trial-balance explicitly as the fallback, not a generic message
steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM (TypeScript/Vitest project): @testing-library/react example-based prop-to-render tests (already scaffolded). STAGE CONTEXT: NEW code, Stage 0, greenfield scaffold. Pure-function render; no fetch, no localStorage. Names GET /health/trial-balance explicitly per US-4 AC.
